description: Fast intake for an idea, pain point, workaround, or frustration. Use it immediately while doing other work; one rough sentence is enough and no solution is required. Stores in the existing tenant-scoped Boardroom Ideas table, starts an ACK-tracked Continuous Improvement triage, and returns the triage deadline. Available to every connected AI account. agent_id required.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the calling agent.

context.description: Optional tiny source pointer or context (max 1000 chars).

thought.description: The raw thought, pain point, or frustration (max 4000 chars).

name: brain_dump
title: Capture a Brain Dump
